name: Kagura
source:
Formerly Katsurou's senior as a host, however he's since graduated from that line of work and is now an ordinary man. He's sometimes still called to help out at events, though. In order to fill up his empty heart, he attempts to steal Shiki away, but...

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
